texts.li: {X_nameDef}, a palmer of {FACTION}, has come to the gate on the way to {PLACE}, walking badly. The road has been hard on {X_objective}, and {X_nameDef} asks whether the colony's doctor, {A_nameDef}, would look at {X_possessive} {TALE} before the walk goes on.

[age0|age1] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has limped up to the gate with a staff and a shell sewn to {X_possessive} hat, on the long walk to {PLACE}. {X_nameDef} has walked on {X_possessive} {TALE} for days now, and asks whether {A_nameDef}, the colony's doctor, could see to it.

[age2|age3] {X_nameDef}, a palmer of {FACTION}, has come to the gate in boots worn through, on foot to {PLACE} as the fellowship still goes. {X_nameDef} has walked on {X_possessive} {TALE} for days now, and asks whether {A_nameDef}, the colony's doctor, could see to it.

[winter] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has come to the gate through the cold, slowly, on the way to {PLACE}. {X_nameDef} has walked on {X_possessive} {TALE} since the last hostel, and asks whether {A_nameDef} could spare the time to see to it.

[their:grateful] {FACTION} think well of the colony, and their palmers say its door is open. {X_nameDef} has come to it on the way to {PLACE}, walking on {X_possessive} {TALE}, to ask whether {A_nameDef} would see to it.

li.label: {A_nameDef} sees to {X_possessive} {TALE} (1 medicine)
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} takes a medicine from the stores out to the gate and sees to {X_nameDef}'s {TALE} there. The palmers at {PLACE} will hear who did it.

li.label: A medicine for the road (1)
li.outcome: A medicine is carried out to {X_nameDef} at the gate, for the {TALE} and the rest of the walk to {PLACE}.

li.label: Keep the gate shut
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} blesses the shut gate all the same, as the fellowship blesses every door, and limps on toward {PLACE}.

lines.li: [tended] Peace on this house, and thank you for the care.
[tended] I will walk easier for it, and the hostel will hear your doctor's name.
[herbs] That will carry me to the next hostel, and I will tell them who gave it.
[shut] Every door is a shrine to someone, and I bless this one as I pass.
[shut] Peace on this house, open or shut.
